prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize & Seal Your Pet Adoption Certificate", "Verify your pet details and customize your official desktop companion seal.", "Companion Name"]
1: ["Signing in automatically restores your existing pets and progress instantly.", "Instant Pet Restoration"]
2: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, summon audio chat, or toggle stealth mode.", "Right-click for Menu | Drag to Move | Double-click to Talk"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Environment", "Verifying screen display layers and initializing desktop companion graphics...", "Initializing pet shaders..."]
4: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Choose whether to pick a pre-built pet or design a custom companion."]
5: ["Upload Pet Photo for 3D Companion Rendering", "Ensure high lighting and clear features for accurate pet creation.", "Clear face view | Good lighting | High contrast"]
6: ["Choose Your Companion Path", "Select standard adoption or custom photo generation to get started."]
7: ["Secure Your Pet & Account Progress", "Sign in to save your adoption status, settings, and unlock multi-device pet syncing safely."]
8: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Your companion is ready. Use right-click or global shortcuts to interact anytime.", "Tip: Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet anytime."]
9: ["Play alert when pet arrives"]
